milestone.title: M28 Tiered Refresh and Polling Strategy

intent.outcome: Refresh is tiered: per-data-class TTLs in config; panels fetch on first select (lazy); auto-refresh and scheduled work pause briefly after user key activity so typing/navigation is not janked by full refresh storms.

problem.description: RefreshMsg always reloads Status+Formulae+Casks+Outdated+Taps+Services. Single 30s cache TTL. Init eager-fetches everything. auto_refresh_seconds exists but still full RefreshMsg. No pause-on-interaction. Builds on M09 outdated TTL/lazy and M11 faster taps.

in_scope: Config: per-class TTLs (formulae, casks, outdated, taps, services, doctor) under brew or cache section; sensible defaults; validate on load.
Lazy panels: Init only loads active panel (or Status+active); other panels fetch on first switchPanel.
RefreshMsg becomes selective: refresh stale classes only, or active panel + stale dependents — document algorithm.
Pause-on-interaction: if key activity within last 500ms (configurable), defer auto_refresh tick once.
Tests for lazy init, per-class TTL plumbing, pause-on-interaction.
out_of_scope: UI for editing TTLs inside the TUI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Config exposes independent TTL fields for at least formulae, casks, outdated, taps (and services or doctor); defaults applied in Default().
With default config, Init does not fetch every panel; inactive panels fetch on first select.
Auto-refresh tick defers when a key was handled within the pause window (default 500ms).
Manual R refresh still forces refresh of the active panel (and documented related classes) even if TTL not expired.

design_decisions.rationale: Outdated lazy/TTL and taps batch are prerequisites so tiered refresh is not papering over N+1/outdated stampede.

design_decisions.choice: R = force active (+ related); auto = stale-only; Init = active-only lazy
design_decisions.rationale: Predictable user mental model; avoids surprise empty panels only until first visit.

steps.action: Add per-class TTL config fields + defaults + validation.
Lazy Init: fetch only active panel (or Status+active); switchPanel fetches unloaded panels.
Selective RefreshMsg by staleness; R forces active (+related). Wire class TTLs to cache/fetch decisions.
Pause-on-interaction: track last key time; auto_refresh defers if within 500ms window.
